reviews.title: Not for cold hands
reviews.text: It works after a workout but can’t analyze my performance because it needs a resting heart rate to compare.  And it can’t measure my heart rate at rest because my hands are too cold.  I tried for a week before deleting.

reviews.title: Tried to charge me for free trial
reviews.text: I have a$44 pending charge when it was a a free trial

reviews.title: Slow and Hard to Work With
reviews.text: I do think the app is organized, however it’s SO difficult to work with and it takes like ten tries each time you want to record your heart rate. I tried using this for a class, but by the time it recorded, my heart rate would lower after a workout. It’s just not reliable and I’ve talked to some of my friends who used this app for the same reason and they had the same issues with it. Do not recommend.

reviews.title: Poor signal quality?
reviews.text: I will watch as the app measures my heart rate and stays in a very narrow range as I hold my finger over the camera for however long. It seems perfect, but then it just says “poor signal quality” with no other explanation. The signal quality was in fact not poor as I watched the data being collected and it seemed to be very consistent throughout the entire process. I need to use this app to properly measure my heart rate, and it is not doing what it claims to be good at.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Every time I used it, it measured the heart rate for quite a long time. Then, at the very end, it said “poor signal” and terminated. This is a terrible product. I deleted it, and I don’t miss it at all.

reviews.title: Didn’t work
reviews.text: Every time I tried said poor signal and couldn’t do a reading no matter how I adjusted the light and camera.  Other similar apps worked much better and actually worked.  Disappointed.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Claims it’s free, demands money for use after download.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work well
reviews.text: Most of the time it can’t get a reading. Not worth it.

reviews.title: Buyer Beware
reviews.text: I thought by the “ heart rate checker and beat analyzer” description that this would actually give me a wave form like an ECG. All it does is give you the whip more like a pulse ox. I’m capable of counting my own pulse so this was a disappointment for me. I’m hoping to get a refund as it’s just been about an hour since I bought it and realized that it wasn’t what I thought it was.

reviews.title: Great when it works.
reviews.text: More often than not I don’t get a reading because of “poor signal quality” no matter what I try to

reviews.title: Dupe for Cardiogram
reviews.text: This app is a dupe for the Cardiogram- do not buy. It does not work as well and is a waste of money. I’m not sure what happened to the original cardiogram if it was discontinued.

reviews.title: Bad readings
reviews.text: This app barely gets readings. It takes 8-10 tries for me to get a reading for an app that claims do be so great it is terrible! Waisted money will not be renewing this app that is for sure!!!!!

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: Horrible app. Keeps saying that I need to warm my fingers or not press too hard. I can’t warm my fingers so that’s not possible. What a joke.
